_doc: clinic-voice-names — SPEC-V10 §4: the page under macOS Voice Control.
In every state of /clinic/book, every interactive control has a non-empty, unique,
short accessible name ('Click <name>' hits exactly one thing without 'Show numbers');
the confirm control names the act AND the time; the book dock takes focus on arm so
'Press Return key' books, and the cancel dock deliberately does not.

eval: (() => { window.__audit = () => { const vis = (el) => !!(el.offsetParent || el.getClientRects().length); const nameOf = (el) => { const al = el.getAttribute('aria-label'); if (al) return al.trim(); const lb = el.getAttribute('aria-labelledby'); if (lb) return lb.split(/\s+/).map((id) => document.getElementById(id)?.textContent ?? '').join(' ').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(); if (el.labels && el.labels.length) return Array.from(el.labels).map((l) => l.textContent).join(' ').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(); const c = el.cloneNode(true); c.querySelectorAll('[aria-hidden="true"]').forEach((n) => n.remove()); return (c.textContent || el.getAttribute('title') || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(); }; const els = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button, a[href], input, select, textarea')).filter((el) => vis(el) && !el.hidden && el.getAttribute('aria-hidden') !== 'true' && el.type !== 'hidden'); const names = els.map(nameOf); const empties = names.filter((n) => !n).length; const seen = new Map(); names.forEach((n) => seen.set(n, (seen.get(n) || 0) + 1)); const dupes = [...seen].filter(([, k]) => k > 1).map(([n]) => n); const long = names.filter((n) => n.split(' ').length > 10); window.__names = names; return empties === 0 && dupes.length === 0 && long.length === 0 ? 'ok' : JSON.stringify({ controls: names.length, empties, dupes, long }); }; return typeof window.__audit; })()

_doc: State 2 — held by the assistant: the book dock takes focus, and its name says act + time.

eval: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('[data-slot-state="open"]'); window.__slot = el.getAttribute('data-clinic-slot'); window.__time = el.querySelector('time, [data-clinic-time]')?.textContent?.trim() || (el.textContent.match(/\d{1,2}:\d{2} (AM|PM)/) || [''])[0]; return /\d{1,2}:\d{2} (AM|PM)/.test(window.__time); })()

_doc: State 3 — booked (a trusted Return on the focused control).
State 4 — cancel armed by the assistant: named with the time, and it does NOT steal focus.

eval: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('[data-clinic-release]'); if (!b) return 'no-release'; b.click(); return 'released'; })()

_doc: State 5 — move armed: named with the TARGET time.

eval: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('[data-slot-state="open"]'); window.__to = el.getAttribute('data-clinic-slot'); window.__toTime = (el.textContent.match(/\d{1,2}:\d{2} (AM|PM)/) || [''])[0]; return /AM|PM/.test(window.__toTime); })()
(() => { const b = document.querySelector('[data-clinic-release]'); if (!b) return 'no-release'; b.click(); return 'released'; })()

_doc: State 6 — permission standing (a trusted Return on the focused grant control).
State 7 — the by-hand form: every field is speakable by its label.

eval: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('[data-slot-state="open"] [data-clinic-action="open-slot"]'); if (!b) return 'no-row'; b.click(); return 'opened'; })()
